summary_1line: Insulted in the Kaurava court, the Pandavas swear deadly vows against their enemies before departing, while Yudhishthira formally bids farewell.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, furious and lion-like, points at Dussasana in the royal assembly while swearing to drink his blood.
Duryodhana mockingly imitates Bhima’s proud gait in the court while the enraged Bhima turns back toward him.
The five Pandava brothers, arms raised and eyes blazing, proclaim their vows of vengeance before leaving the Kaurava court.
